about: Heaven before and after: structure short 5 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md). Blender: two octagons of glowing trigrams; the trigrams move from one arrangement to the other. Queued overnight 2026-10-01. Draft 1, copy only.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: 100 bpm, G minor, from 127 s as on 28; serious rather than bright, no other structure short uses it

caption: The eight trigrams have two classic circles: Earlier Heaven, where opposites face each other, and Later Heaven, which follows the seasons.

pages.q: HOW ARE THE EIGHT TRIGRAMS ARRANGED
pages.a:
TWO CLASSIC CIRCLES.
EARLIER HEAVEN 先天
AND LATER HEAVEN 後天.

TRADITION: FU XI AND KING WEN.
AS DIAGRAMS: THE SONG DYNASTY,
AFTER 960.

OPPOSITES FACE EACH OTHER.
HEAVEN 天 ACROSS FROM EARTH 地.
EVERY LINE CHANGED.

THE YEAR GOING ROUND.
THUNDER 雷 IN THE EAST,
WHERE SPRING STARTS.

ONE CIRCLE OF BALANCE.
ONE CIRCLE OF TIME.
